name: Infertility
seoDescription: It is the biological inability of a person to contribute to conception. There could be many biological reasons for infertility. We have treatment for all types
contentHtml:
It is the biological inability of a person to contribute to conception. There could be many biological reasons for infertility. We have treatment for all types of infertility in men and women. In Omshree Sidha Hospital we have special medicines to increase the count and mobility of sperm. Even if there is not enough sperm to count in the test, (even if the count is zero) we will increase the count to the normal level. We have medicines that would take care of women related infertility and pregnancy problems too. We have solutions to ovary related problems like cysts etc… We will make your life more happy and beautiful.   Our treatment consists of internal medicines and external medicines.  He or she may feel difference in their capacity in the first day of our treatment itself.  Panchakarma too helps in removing the toxins and increase the blood circulation.   The treatment and medicines differ according to the condition of the patient.

This is pure ayurvedic and free from side effects, at the same time it is having side benefits.   You and your partner will enjoy the life much better than before.  Your general health  will improve and you may feel more powerful than earlier.  Our treatment is comparatively cost effective and give you result in a short time.

In most cases you will get result in two to twelve months time.  The duration depends on the age of the patient, the cause, severity of the problem  etc….
